page.overview:
Who is Quickthinx Allthoughts?

Quickthinx Allthoughts is a non-playable character goblin from Final Fantasy XIV. The mastermind of the Illuminati, he is the antagonist of the Alexander storyline introduced in the Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward expansion.

Quickthinx Allthoughts came across the Enigma Codex that included the plans for a walking citadel that could sustain many scholars as they studied the realm. For a nomadic race like the goblins, the idea was appealing. The Illuminati have little to no regard for the lives of others, and so Quickthinx had no qualms about summoning a primal to power the citadel.

As the adventurer infiltrated the primal fortress to shut it down, Quickthinx deployed numerous goblin soldiers and mecha to halt the invasion. He even confronted the adventurer in combat personally, piloting a goblin tank. Though he was defeated, he escaped and later claimed that he had feigned defeat in order to further his ultimate goals. He was later able to steal the final piece of the Enigma Codex, a relic needed to activate Alexander, from the adventurer's group by seemingly being able to predict the future, due to Alexander's ability to control time itself. He captured Roundrox, a young goblin capable of controlling the Enigma Codex, and by extension, Alexander. With everything he needed in his hands, Quickthinx addressed his Illuminati underlings and revealed his plans of using Alexander to rewrite history, creating a perfect world that he would control.

When the adventurer and their companions breached Alexander to rescue Roundrox, Alexander activated, and temporarily sent them back in time three years. While in the past, the book that recorded their deeds concerning Alexander was lost. Quickthinx found this record three years ago, and used it to gain knowledge of the future and form his plans for Alexander, thus creating a time loop.
